## Objective
- Build a complete, playable hide-and-seek game featuring ten rooms, locked doors, keys hidden in drawers, empty drawers, grey and blue lockers, white walls, and blue floors in a 3D style.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html` using canvas-based first-person raycasting, with keyboard, mouse, and mobile touch controls.
- Chose a seeker that activates after a brief delay; players search drawers, unlock doors, and hide in lockers to evade it.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable ten-room game with keys, empty drawers, locked doors, grey/blue lockers, seeker, escape/found outcomes, and responsive controls.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Ran the game in Playwright and confirmed the console had no errors after fixing a raycasting bug.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/game.jpg` (the screenshots directory is ignored by git).

Implemented the playable hide-and-seek game in `index.html`. It includes ten rooms, locked doors, keys and empty drawers, grey and blue lockers, and a seeker.

Assumption: the seeker activates after a brief delay; search drawers for keys, unlock doors, and hide in lockers to evade the seeker. The game supports keyboard, mouse, and mobile touch controls. Syntax and browser play were checked.
